Inside the BMW Performance Center Track Program

For luxury vehicle buyers and automotive enthusiasts, experiencing high-performance dynamics on a closed course provides an unprecedented look into vehicle engineering. Located in Greer, South Carolina—directly across the highway from BMW’s massive Spartanburg manufacturing facility—the BMW Performance Center operates as the brand's primary North American track laboratory, allowing guests to evaluate multiple distinct models across the lineup under professional instruction.

Guided by Chief Driving Instructor Matt Mullins, the curriculum focuses on fundamental vehicle physics and high-speed car control. Drivers are coached through critical track disciplines, including high-speed vision targeting, threshold braking, and testing anti-lock braking systems (ABS) while cornering at maximum mechanical grip.
